commitThreshold: a bounded two-edge accord with separated edge folds
memoryRule: the offered pair stays geometrically exact; an unoffered counterfold opens, a remote hinge tightens, and an echo changes crease geometry; four refusals remain liftable
interactionRule: pointerdown on one edge and pointerup at a separated edge commits; Enter, Space, and the accord control use deterministic pairs; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: independent cut cells, open SVG filaments, and a closed attention body -> split-margin angular folds around a withheld middle
compositionRupture: broken constellation, off-axis spine, and enclosing body -> two quiet margins with a deliberately empty central negotiation space
encounterRupture: proximity tour, drawn stroke, and bounded dwell -> one two-edge offer whose endpoints remain exact and whose answer turns elsewhere
temporalRupture: vacancy migration, filament inheritance, and topology cuts -> refusal memory that compounds remote counterfold, hinge, and echo roles
mediumRupture: independent cut paths, open strokes, and even-odd body -> angular SVG fold paths with produced crease signatures
changedRule: A separated pair is offered but not connected. The endpoints stay exact; an unoffered counterfold, hinge, and echo carry the refusal through actual SVG geometry.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a split-margin field of twelve angular folds and a withheld middle. A committed pair changes three remote folds through path, notch, scale, angle, and crease geometry; four refusals persist.
falsifier: Delete if the pair deforms, if the offer line persists, if remote roles are only colour/readout, if the field reads as a grid or diagram, if later accords reset, or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v038 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the counterfold field from v035-v037's body, filament, score, or cut-cell grammars.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
